tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sbyin sreg gi tho yig 'chi med 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti bi dza ya/ rnam par rgyal ma'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung zhing kha skong ba dang / sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ zhi ba'i thab lag len ltar byas te/ lha dgu'i mtshan ma bkod/ kha khyer gyi steng du bud shing brtsig shar lho'i mtshams su me tshang ting lo bzhag thab kyi zhal nub tu phyogs par byas pa'i mdun du sgrub pa po'i stan dang / bsang chu/ rdo dril/ dgang blugs/ me yol dkar rtsis byugs te ti se'i gangs su bsgom/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas nas yam shing mar til sogs bsreg rdzas bcu gcig bsham/ g.yon nas chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga/ de mdun 'das gtor me lha dang / cha gsum gtor ma bsham/ snga dro'am phyi dro'i dus su khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas 'byor na gos rgyan dkar po bya/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par bya/ a mri ta nyer gcig gis bsangs chu byin gyis brlabs/ rdzas rnams la gtor te bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las grub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ gzungs ring gsum bzlas te/ yam shing gi rtse la ras mar sbags pa'i spor 'des me spar te/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing thab la g.yas nas lan gsum bskor te/ ting lo sbar rtswa skam po mar sogs kyis me gso/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba'i bskor ba nang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/

rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ thab tu me tog phul la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ thab kyi dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ me lha dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ spro na ku sha spyi ltar phul/ me lha'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa sogs kyis dmigs pa spyi ltar gsal btab te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ bdun gyi mthar ag+na ye a dī bya sogs lan gsum gyi byon skyems phul/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i mchod pa dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdun la sogs pa phul/ spel tshig 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ 'bul sngags rdzas sngags sam lha sngags gang rung gis bya/ gzhung las skabs 'dir me lha gshegs gsol bshad kyang 'dir spyi ltar bya/ mar blug gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ me bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sogs nas lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar gyi lha bskyed/ nye snying sngon 'gro'i byon skyems lan gsum gong ltar phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod kyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs kyis bstod/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams brgya re 'bul/ rdzas sngags oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa la sogs pa rnams gsum tsam re sngon du btang nas/ nus na gzungs ring mi nus na nye snying gis phul/ spel tshig brgya re'i mjug tu/ bdag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsag pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang /

gsang sngags kyi lhag chad thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bsreg rdzas thams cad ma 'byor na yam shing bcas til tsam gyis chog bsnyen pa'i kha skong bcu cha'i til 'bul/ slar yang gong byon skyems ltar mar dgang blugs gsum dang / mchod pa kha gsos te mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab bya/ de nas cha gsum btang / yig brgya ci nus dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyi nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis ye shes pa gshegs/ thab kyi rdul cung zad dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blug oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams ci rigs phul/ byon skyems ltar gshegs skyems phul/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te mtshan sngags kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas phul/ mchod bstod dang / me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams sogs kyis 'dod don zhus/ ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o/ /de ltar thun gnyis gsum gzhi bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi bcu cha'i kha skong nam 'grig par bya/ grol mtshams snga dro la bya/ mthar thal ba rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor ba sogs bya'o/ /rgyas pa la sogs pa rnams kyang de dang de'i khyad par gyi bsam pa dang ldan pas/ de dang de'i khyad par gyi rdzas rnams dang thab la sogs pa spyi'agro ltar shes par bya zhing / phan yon gzungs dang rtogs pa/ de'i ṭī ka rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa dang / rnam rgyal rnam bshad mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa sogs zhib tu blta'o/ /zhes gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sbyin sreg gi tho yig 'chi med 'od snang zhes bya ba 'di yang bsnyen pa bgyid pa'i sgrub pa po rnams la phan pa'i ched du dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bkod pa dge legs 'phel/
